title: Real Conversations
description: Small talk, being a guest, and holding a full conversation from hello to goodbye.

lessons.title: Small talk
lessons.goal: Fill a pause with weather and pleasantries.
notes: The weather is a safe opener anywhere: ajj bahut garmi hai.
ki haal hai? / kujh nahin is the Punjabi equivalent of "what's up?" / "not much".

lessons.title: Being a guest
lessons.goal: Survive — and enjoy — a visit to a Punjabi home.
notes: You will be told to sit and to eat, repeatedly. Accepting once and then saying bas ji is the normal rhythm.
main challda han, "I'll get going", is how you start to leave without seeming abrupt.

dialogue.speaker: Host
dialogue.pa: ਆਓ ਜੀ, ਬੈਠੋ ਜੀ। ਚਾਹ ਪੀਓਗੇ?
dialogue.roman: ao ji, baitho ji. chah pioge?
dialogue.en: Come in, sit down. Will you have tea?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pa: ਜ਼ਰੂਰ ਜੀ। ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਘਰ ਬਹੁਤ ਵਧੀਆ ਹੈ।
dialogue.roman: zarur ji. tuhada ghar bahut vadhia hai.
dialogue.en: Certainly. Your home is very nice.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pa: ਬਸ ਜੀ, ਬਹੁਤ ਧੰਨਵਾਦ। ਹੁਣ ਮੈਂ ਚੱਲਦਾ ਹਾਂ।
dialogue.roman: bas ji, bahut dhannvad. hun main challda han.
dialogue.en: That's enough, thank you very much. I'll get going now.

lessons.title: The whole conversation
lessons.goal: Run a complete exchange, hello to goodbye, using everything you have learned.
notes: Everything here is a recombination of Units 1-9. If a phrase feels new, it is only new furniture in a familiar room.
Say the closing dialogue out loud twice before you finish the course. That is the real test.

dialogue.speaker: Ravi
dialogue.pa: ਸਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ ਜੀ! ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਹੋ?
dialogue.roman: sat sri akal ji! tusin kiven ho?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pa: ਸਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ। ਮੈਂ ਠੀਕ ਹਾਂ, ਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ?
dialogue.roman: sat sri akal. main thik han, te tusin?

dialogue.speaker: Ravi
dialogue.pa: ਸਭ ਠੀਕ ਹੈ। ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਨਾਂ ਕੀ ਹੈ?
dialogue.roman: sabh thik hai. tuhada naan ki hai?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pa: ਮੇਰਾ ਨਾਂ ਟੌਮ ਹੈ। ਮੈਂ ਅਮਰੀਕਾ ਤੋਂ ਹਾਂ।
dialogue.roman: mera naan Tom hai. main amrika ton han.
dialogue.en: My name is Tom. I'm from America.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pa: ਮੈਂ ਥੋੜ੍ਹੀ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਬੋਲਦਾ ਹਾਂ। ਮੈਨੂੰ ਪੰਜਾਬੀ ਚੰਗੀ ਲੱਗਦੀ ਹੈ।
dialogue.roman: main thorhi panjabi bolda han. mainu panjabi changi laggdi hai.
dialogue.en: I speak a little Punjabi. I like Punjabi.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.pa: ਮਿਲਦੇ ਰਹਾਂਗੇ। ਸਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਕਾਲ ਜੀ।
dialogue.roman: milde rahange. sat sri akal ji.
